name: app-shater-admin-persona-key-needs-with-desktop-analytics
title: Shater admin persona 'the mind managing the system' key needs with a full desktop analytics screen
whatItIs: A pale blue slide numbered 03 with 'لوحة التحكم — العقل المدبر للمنظومة' (Control Panel — the mind managing the system), five pill needs (handling complaints, managing services, managing users and craftsmen, tracking orders, managing payments), a faded 'Shater' wordmark, and a full desktop dashboard screenshot with stat cards, a chart and a sidebar.
whatItMeans: Systems-level and confident; treating the admin as a persona too completes the three-sided user picture.
techniques: Treat the internal operator as a persona, same as external users.
Close a three-persona set with a summary line.
Show the admin's real screen at full desktop size.

vocabulary.definition: A persona who operates rather than uses the product externally.
A vertical menu along a dashboard's edge.
